senses.gloss:
√mil (miláti; miméla; miliṣyáti; militá;
militvā́; -mílya). meet; assemble. [cf.
Lat. mille, ‘assemblage, host, thousand,’
pl. mīl-ia, whence the borrowed Eng.
mile, ‘a thousand (paces), mīlia passuum’;
 perhaps mīl-it-es, ‘going in companies
or troops’ and so, like Eng. troops,
‘soldiers.’]
